summary: scripts/ci-local runs the tests with their temporary files in RAM when /dev/shm has room, and 12 at a time: the warm linux-gate tests stage on a build host went from about 25 minutes to 9

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: CI is unchanged. Locally, CI_LOCAL_TMP_ROOT and CI_TEST_THREADS still name the root and the thread count; the commands the stages run and the notes they sign are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Set CI_LOCAL_TMP_ROOT=/var/tmp and CI_TEST_THREADS=6, or revert this change.
